key_insight: CADAQUES makes cost a first-class part of autonomous discovery, jointly budgeting query execution and decision-making across time, compute, money, and tokens.
engineering_relevance: The framework gives researchers a practical architecture for building query-efficient scientific discovery loops where both simulators and LLM-driven planners are explicitly metered.
method: Splits the loop into an Oracle that answers queries and a Driver that proposes them.
Tracks both evaluations and decisions against a shared vector-valued budget.
Uses an append-only ledger to record declared vs. settled costs for every transaction.
evidence_signal: On the 2D Ising critical-temperature task, low-fidelity exploration followed by higher-fidelity refinement produced lower and less variable error than using high fidelity throughout at the studied budget scale.
watch_item: Because cost accounting is centralized, the main implementation risk is ensuring that declared and settled costs are measured consistently across diverse oracles and planners.
paper_title: CADAQUES: A Cost-Aware Dual Architecture for Query-Efficient Autonomous Discovery
